responsibility: Defines the parsing, validation, and template-formatting machinery for `#[rustc_on_unimplemented]` annotations, turning trait or impl attributes into structured directives with conditional subcommands and checked format strings that later diagnostics can instantiate from trait arguments and contextual options.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `traits/error_reporting/on_unimplemented.rs`, which applies `#[rustc_on_unimplemented]` during trait-error reporting using obligation-specific context, this file is context-independent infrastructure: it parses the attribute from traits/impls, validates allowed placeholders and `on(...)` conditions, stores the directive structure, and formats templates once given trait arguments and option values.
